An '''unspeakable horror''' (elite) is an [[elite monster|elite version]] of the [[unspeakable horror]] that has a chance to spawn upon killing an unspeakable horror. Elite spawn rates can be further increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense stick]]s.

Caution should be taken while fighting them in melee range, as their special attack is able to ignore the protection of a [[witchwood icon]].
